composite_source_regression.scope: Low-degree test of the a_v regression prediction for the composite source, not an all-degree proof by enumeration.

centered_zero_bridge.scope: Exact finite-degree diagram cancellations after the displayed deterministic regressions. These finite checks alone do not establish general spectral absolute continuity, convergence of exact energy pinching, or a time kernel.

conventions: Moment order is <F^dagger H^a G H^b>. Dagger reverses marks and Wick groups. Composite sources have a whole v+w Wick block but a size mark only on its v subblock. The OU degree is raw field slots minus twice the number of pairs internal to that whole field; external energy slots are excluded. Every field retains its physical energy degree, so C restores as C^((j+k+a+b)/2). No samplewise pinching is executed.
scope: Full finite Gaussian-Hermite versus coordinate-pairing comparisons use full-Fock half-size and floating normalized CAR matrices. The formal signed lambda/q polynomials and centered no-bridge cancellations are exact fixed-degree chord computations under the established pair-Poisson rule. No finite-N rank=size substitution, arbitrary-degree proof by finite enumeration, interval arithmetic, or full-time pinched/charged memory kernel is claimed.
reproducibility: Only this new main is executed. Historical sources and outputs are unchanged; output is exclusive-create.
